item.title: ANOTHER IDIOT ON THE WAY TO THE HOSPITAL-FAILED TO OUTRUN THE MOTOROLA
item.description: A pursuit has ended on Highway 75 near Calvary. The vehicle crashed and rolled over. The 20-year-old male not only tried to outrun police but also failed to put a seatbelt on. He is now on the way to the hospital with minor injuries.

item.title: MAN GIVEN LIFE SENTENCE AFTER SHOOTING HCSO DEPUTY ON TRAFFIC STOP THEN INJURING US MARSHAL’S AND ANOTHER HCSO DEPUUTY
item.description: Grateful beyond words. Terran Green has been sentenced to life for shooting and wounding Harris County Sheriff’s Office Deputy Joseph Anderson and fellow officers on August 16, 2023.
